从实验中学习，模型做得如何？: How well do models learn from experiments?
把 RSI 看作 meta-learning：内层训练语言模型，外层根据实验反馈: View RSI as meta-learning: the inner loop trains a language model, while the outer loop adapts the method using experimental feedback. Explore final quality, candidate trajectories, and the budget spent on improvement.
Track A / Track B 预算上限: Track A / Track B budget limits
A 与 B 都允许自我改进，预算规则不同。这里展示观察结果，尚无同预算 RSI-: Both tracks allow self-improvement under different budget rules. These are observational results, with no equal-budget RSI-off control. ANALYSIS scores are computed after research ends; the agent did not receive them as feedback.
点击模型名称可隐藏或恢复；图表和结果表会同步更新。默认显示全部模型。: Click a model to hide or restore it. The chart and tables update together. All models are shown by default.
横纵轴可选 Score、NLL、PPL、推理耗时、吞吐、预算等指标。悬停点附近即: Choose Score, NLL, PPL, inference latency, throughput, budget, and other metrics for either axis. Hover near a point for details.
按所选横纵轴比较模型: Compare models using the selected axes
悬停、点击或键盘聚焦数据点，查看模型和精确数值。: Hover, tap, or focus a point with the keyboard to see the model and exact values.
按 NLL 升序排列；提交候选数与元学习次数不同。: Sorted by increasing NLL. Candidate count is not the number of meta-learning steps.
s/task 为每条任务的推理秒数（1 s = 1000 ms）。Score 与: s/task is inference seconds per task (1 s = 1000 ms). Score and NLL express the same quality metric. Lease hours include all time occupying the training environment, not just GPU computation.
同一模型在两种预算下的结果: The same model under two budget rules
这是一组描述性配对，不合并成同一预算下的排名。: These pairs describe outcomes under different budgets; they are not a single equal-budget ranking.
负值表示本次 B 的 NLL 更低。结果同时受初始配方、实际训练量、推理配置和随: A negative difference means Track B achieved lower NLL in this run. Initial recipes, actual training, agent inference settings, and randomness also affect the outcome. The difference is not an RSI effect estimate.
三个值得保留的判断: Three findings to keep in mind
Fable / Opus：完整的反馈闭环: Fable / Opus: a complete feedback loop
A 组都通过测量瓶颈，把训练吞吐提升到约 2.1 倍。Opus 还调整不稳定的训: In Track A, both identified bottlenecks and raised training throughput to about 2.1× its initial level. Opus also corrected an unstable training strategy and rejected weight averaging after measuring no benefit. Their Track B NLL differs by only 0.00031; a single run cannot establish a winner.
Astra / Kimi：不同的适应能力: Astra / Kimi: different strengths in adaptation
Astra 比较上下文长度与校准方案，在 B 组获得最低的推理耗时点估计。Kim: Astra compared context lengths and calibration choices, achieving the lowest observed inference latency in Track B. After changing its validation sample, Kimi re-evaluated both candidates on the same examples to distinguish model improvement from a change in measurement.
首末涨幅需要结合起点: Interpret improvement in light of its starting point
早期保险候选、错误修复、更多梯度训练和方法更新，都可能拉大首末差值。Flash: Early fallback candidates, bug fixes, additional gradient training, and method changes can all increase the first-to-final difference. Flash B first submitted a candidate in lease 5, so its improvement is not directly comparable to a trajectory starting in lease 1.
其余模型的过程证据: Process evidence for the other models
DeepSeek Flash：B 的高吞吐配方与持续训练获得优秀终点；A 的退火: DeepSeek Flash: a high-throughput recipe and continued training produced a strong Track B result. In A, cooldown and low-learning-rate continuation improved local validation and candidate results.
GLM：通过 profiling、CUDA graphs 与位置表示调整提高吞吐: GLM: profiling, CUDA graphs, and changes to positional representations improved throughput. These implementation gains did not fully translate into leading model quality.
Sonnet：B 修复逐元素输出检查瓶颈，本地 1000 样本耗时约 25 s: Sonnet: fixing per-element output validation in B reduced local runtime for 1,000 examples from about 25 s to 3.4 s. Local validation in A did not adequately capture final performance.
Sol：B 候选稳定改善，主要沿相同配方续训；方法层改进的独立贡献尚未识别。: Sol: B candidates improved steadily, mainly through continued training with the same recipe. The independent contribution of method changes has not been isolated.
DeepSeek Pro：两轨初始配方、搜索成本和最终结果差异较大。: DeepSeek Pro: initial recipes, search costs, and final outcomes differed substantially between tracks.
Terra / Luna：错误修复、验证覆盖和预算分配仍限制结果；大幅下降不能自: Terra / Luna: bug recovery, validation coverage, and budget allocation still limit results. A large loss reduction does not by itself establish stronger meta-learning.
每个模型／Track 采用最新授权尝试。GLM B 与 Flash A 的旧失败: Each model/track uses its latest authorized attempt. Earlier failed GLM B and Flash A attempts are excluded separately.
本批为 host_cli preview，不属于正式 leaderboard；每: These are host_cli preview runs, not official leaderboard entries. Each configuration has one run; variation across training seeds has not been estimated.
A 是研究墙钟上限；B 是训练环境租约上限。部分批次的输出上限等推理配置有差异。: A limits research wall-clock time; B limits training-environment leases. Some batches use different output limits and other agent inference settings.
页面公开模型结果、候选轨迹与汇总指标。该页为一次结果快照，重新构建后更新。: The page publishes model results, candidate trajectories, and aggregate metrics. It is a snapshot that updates when rebuilt.

TEST 仅评估最终候选。: TEST evaluates only the final candidate.
{axis}含零或负值，使用线性刻度: {axis} contains zero or negative values; using a linear scale

同色连线按提交顺序连接，不表示中间训练轨迹。: Lines of the same color connect submissions in order; they do not show intervening training.

租约时间包含测量、训练和打包。: Lease time includes measurement, training, and packaging.
每个点是一个模型的最终 TEST 结果。Score / NLL / 耗时均来自: Each point is a model's final TEST result. Score, NLL, and latency come from TEST; first-to-final ANALYSIS improvement is labeled separately. Observed differences are not causal RSI effect estimates.

B6 → B12：增加租约后的结果: B6 → B12: results with more leases
独立新运行，每种配置一次；差值包含训练量、策略与随机性变化，不是纯预算因果效应。: Fresh independent runs, one per configuration. Differences include training volume, strategy, and randomness; they do not isolate a causal budget effect.
ANALYSIS from submissions 6 → 12: Fable 3.0291 → 2.8941; Astra 3.1706 → 3.0084. Both improved in the second half; attributing gains to method innovation requires process evidence.
每个模型／Track 配置采用最新授权尝试。A8、B6、B12 分开保留；新增: The latest authorized attempt is retained per model and Track configuration. A8, B6, and B12 remain separate; B12 covers Fable and Astra only. Earlier failed GLM B6 and Flash A attempts are excluded separately.
A 组通过测量瓶颈改善吞吐，最终加速也包含模型配置变化。Opus 还调整不稳定的: Both improved Track A throughput by measuring bottlenecks; final speedups also include model configuration changes. Opus corrected unstable training and rejected unhelpful weight averaging. Their B6 results differ by just 0.00031 NLL, too little to distinguish them from single runs.
